description_short.value: Ghanaian universal bank majority-owned by France's Societe Generale group.
description_short.source: Written by us from the Societe Generale Ghana PLC 2024 Annual Report (GSE PR 070/2025, report of the directors: nature of business, holding company)

description_full.value: Societe Generale Ghana PLC is licensed by the Bank of Ghana as a universal bank. It is a subsidiary of the French Societe Generale group, which owns 60.22% of its shares through its wholly owned SG Financial Services Holding. A wholly owned subsidiary, SSB Investments Limited, manages the bank's equity investments. The company was incorporated in February 1975 and has been listed on the Ghana Stock Exchange since 13 October 1995. Its head office is on Ring Road Central in Accra.
